title: perfect sunset in Barcelona
text: “What a fantastic way to spend the evening! Watching the sunset from the sailboat was unforgettable. Lluís was incredibly kind, professional, and made us feel at home from the very beginning. The whole trip was smooth, peaceful, and exceeded our expectations. If you’re visiting Barcelona, this is an experience you shouldn’t miss!”
author: C7067FTmaurol

title: Fun, Music, and Gentle Sunset Views
text:
This sunset boat cruise was amazing!

The boat is smaller and more intimate than we had realized, but can fit  way more people than we thought as well!  There is a bathroom on board of needed, and enough space on the boat to have a dance party with a Bluetooth speaker on  the front of the boat, and a quieter peaceful viewing group on the other half of the boat (or vice versa) 

Our guide was lovely and informative, and brought drinks and snacks to and from any group as they needed them.
